name: oss-hygiene-remove-orphan-file-and-dead-modules
title: Remove the stray orphans junk file and 3 confirmed-dead source modules (OSS hygiene)
description: Pre-open-source hygiene. Delete a stray 5-byte junk file 'orphans' (content 'NO -', a shell-redirect mistake) at repo root, and 3 confirmed-dead source modules whose basenames AND exported symbols have zero references anywhere in the codebase: packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts, packages/main/src/core/phase-protocol.ts, packages/main/src/verifier/bridge-utils.ts. Excluded from this story: verifier/dev-cli.ts (the lattice serve launcher — invocation path unconfirmed, not certain-dead), the omx disable guard (intentional, AGENTS.md-protected), the .codex/.Codex consolidation (separate decision), and the .lattice gitignore/untrack (must be an OSS-export-time step because gitignoring .lattice would break the self-hosting workflow's metadata commits).

events.reason: REVIEW found intent-coverage.ts is NOT dead: fixture-preview-runner-parity.json dynamically imports dist/core/intent-coverage.js by path (concept finding F-001). The frozen CHK-002 title names all 3 modules incl intent-coverage, so recreating with corrected scope (orphans + phase-protocol + bridge-utils only; intent-coverage KEPT) is cleaner than descoping a frozen requirement.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the keyword verifier only appears as part of the file path packages/main/src/verifier/bridge-utils.ts (one of the dead modules being deleted), not because this story modifies the validation/verifier framework. This is a pure deletion of a confirmed-dead module (CreateBridgeOptions type, 0 references) plus a junk file; no validation-framework logic is changed.
